explication: ETL is a header-only C++ library for deterministic, resource-conscious embedded software, offering fixed-capacity containers and reusable utilities and frameworks. The principal workflow is that an application developer selects ETL headers and uses their APIs in application code; the library provides compile-time and stack-based storage without heap allocation. The graph groups major documented capabilities, not a runtime call sequence. The tree and README support these capability branches, but sampled source is limited, so internal connections between unsampled modules are omitted.
